build.command: mkdir -p ../cloud-functions/vendor && rm -rf ../cloud-functions/vendor/app && cp -r ../backend/app ../cloud-functions/vendor/app && find ../cloud-functions/vendor -name '__pycache__' -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find ../cloud-functions/vendor -name '*.db*' -delete 2>/dev/null; find ../cloud-functions/vendor -name '.env' -delete 2>/dev/null; find ../cloud-functions/vendor -name '.selfheal.log' -delete 2>/dev/null; npm --prefix frontend run build
